verdict.rationale: Opting out of vendor telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a monitoring platform with SDKs, a CLI and a self-hosted edition, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no opt-out switch for Sentry's own telemetry or usage tracking. Self-hosting (sentry-docs-11) is a deployment option, not a documented opt-out control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
